text: @opc/dsh-file-attachments 是面向 DSH 网页端的通用附件插件：它把附件栏接入对话输入区域，并在主机侧提供会话附件接口及 Agent 工具。用户可在对话中拖放或粘贴文件，查看图片、视频和其他文件的类型预览与上传状态，也可拖入文件夹并查看目录清单。Agent 工具支持列出、读取、提取、搜索和整理当前会话附件；用户明确要求时，还可将文件导入 OPC 素材或知识库。适合需要在 DSH 对话中提交和处理多种文件的网页端用户。核心附件流程不需额外服务；显式导入需配置 OPC 地址与会话签名密钥。

@opc/dsh-file-attachments adds drag-and-drop and paste files to DSH web conversations, with previews, upload status and folder support. Agent tools find and read session files. Optional imports send files to an OPC asset or knowledge API and need its URL and a signing secret.

让 Agent 能查找并读取当前会话里收到的文件。

@opc/dsh-file-attachments 的功能「对话附件栏」：在 DSH 对话中拖放或粘贴文件后显示附件卡片、进度和预览；上传分块并校验 SHA-256。
@opc/dsh-file-attachments 的功能「附件 Agent 工具」：Agent 可列出、读取、提取、搜索和整理当前会话附件；用户明确要求时可导入 OPC 素材或知识库。
@opc/dsh-file-attachments 使用前须知：显式导入会把附件内容发送到配置的 OPC API；核心附件流程不依赖该服务，导入需配置 OPC 地址与签名密钥（见 src/index.ts:81-89）。

@opc/dsh-file-attachments README · DSH Universal File Attachments：Session-scoped universal file attachments for [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-Harness).

It replaces path injection with a compact attachment rail: images, videos,
audio, documents, archives, unknown files, and folders are kept as safe,
session-scoped attachments. Browser and agent tooling receive attachment IDs,
never a local machine path.

@opc/dsh-file-attachments README · Features：- Drag or paste files directly into a DSH conversation. No extra picker UI.
- Preview images and videos; show type cards for documents, audio, archives,
  folders, and other files.
- Chunked uploads with SHA-256 finalization and a 2 GB per-file / 10 GB batch
  limit.
- Session, tenant, user, and agent isolation on every host route.
- Agent tools for listing, reading, extracting, searching, materializing, and
  explicitly importing attachments into an asset or knowledge service.
- Safe folder manifests: relative paths only; `.git`, `node_modules`,
  `.DS_Store`, device files, and unsafe paths are rejected.

@opc/dsh-file-attachments README · Platform support：| Capability | Windows Chrome / Edge | macOS Chrome | Firefox |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| File drag and paste | Supported | Supported | Supported |
| Image / video previews | Supported | Supported | Supported |
| Folder drag with directory tree | Supported | Supported | Browser fallback only |
| Chunked file upload | Supported | Supported | Supported |

@opc/dsh-file-attachments README · Install：From a local clone:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/13323232dong/dsh-file-attachments.git
cd dsh-file-attachments
npm install
npm run build

Restart the DSH web process after installation. The plugin occupies the
`conversation.input.attachments` slot with a higher-priority universal rail,
so remove other plugins that independently consume document-level file-drop
events.

@opc/dsh-file-attachments README · Configuration：The core attachment store works without external services. Optional explicit
imports to an OPC-compatible asset or knowledge API need server-side settings:

```yaml
- id: opc-file-attachments
  config:
    apiBaseUrl: https://your-opc-api.example
    identityHmacSecret: !!js process.env.OPC_DSH_IDENTITY_HMAC_SECRET

Never expose `identityHmacSecret` to the browser. The browser sends only its
current DSH session ID; the host resolves the principal and signs outbound
requests.
